description: This file contains automated tests for browser click interactions using Playwright testing framework, including single click, double click, right click, clicks with modifiers, and clicks via test ID attribute.

methods.name: browser_click
methods.description: Test for performing a standard click on a button element.

methods.name: browser_click (double)
methods.description: Test for performing a double click on a heading element.

methods.name: browser_click (right)
methods.description: Test for performing a right-click (context menu) on a button element.

methods.name: browser_click (modifiers)
methods.description: Tests for clicking with modifier keys such as Control, Shift, and Alt.

methods.name: browser_click (test id attribute)
methods.description: Test for clicking an element identified by a test ID attribute.
